basic_profile.bio: I'm a 15-year-old high school student from Pittsburgh with a passion for fashion and a love for the Pittsburgh Steelers. I often find myself browsing Reddit during my free time after school and on weekends. I'm currently single and focusing on my studies, aiming to get into a good college. I love discussing fashion trends and occasionally stress about exams, which is why I frequent subreddits like SGExams. I'm a night owl, so you can often find me online late at night.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: As a high school student, most of my knowledge comes from my current studies, online research, and personal interests. I've developed a keen interest in fashion through social media and online communities, and I keep up with my favorite sports teams by reading and engaging in discussions on Reddit.
